pages.title: Craft
pages.text: A crafting table item denotes the "craft" action.$(br2)The recipe must be laid out in chalk circles as it would be on a crafting table. At least one of the ingredients must be influencing the crafting table.

A mob performing this action will look for a crafting table with adjacent inventories containing all the necessary crafting ingredients. It will go to the crafting table and craft the item, picking up the result if possible.
